use: Lost Circuit '94 ground (ARCADE-ROADMAP A4): scanned roadside boulders, stones and canyon crags, and the terrain material's track, verge and forest-floor scans.

assets.title: Rock Moss Set 01, Rock Moss Set 02, Boulder 01
assets.changes: 1K glTF downloads. Each rock welded, re-centred with its base at y=0 and decimated to a near and a far LOD: Boulder_0-5 (Rock Moss Set 01) 1,700 / 420 triangles, Stone_0-6 (Rock Moss Set 02) 760 / 200, Crag_0 (Boulder 01) 2,600 / 640. Original 1K textures re-encoded as JPEG quality 88. Runtime tint, moss and buried-base shading.

assets.title: Forest Ground 05
assets.creator: Charlotte Baglioni
assets.changes: 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps re-encoded as JPEG quality 85. Normalised by its mean as the track's grain; the stage palette sets the colour.

assets.title: Forest Ground 01
assets.creator: Rob Tuytel
assets.changes: 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps re-encoded as JPEG quality 85. Runtime tint for the verge.

assets.title: Brown Mud Leaves 01
assets.creator: Rob Tuytel
assets.changes: 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps re-encoded as JPEG quality 85. Runtime tint; sampled twice (once axis-swapped) to hide tiling.
